blocks.text: Graph aisa data structure hai jo vertices (ya nodes) ke majmooe aur unhein jorne wali edges se banta hai. Graphs rabton ke network dikhane ke liye istemal hote hain, jahan har rabta do vertices ke darmiyan ek rishta hai. Vertices kuch bhi ho sakte hain, jaise shehar, log ya koi khayal (concept), aur edges un ke darmiyan rishte ya raaste hain.

Sochiye aap Pakistan ke saare shehron aur unhein jorne wali sarkon ka naqsha bana rahe hain. Har shehar ek vertex hai aur do shehron ke darmiyan har sarak ek edge. Tree ke bar-aks graph ki koi ek “root” nahi hoti aur na hi oopar-neeche wali darja-bandi. Graph mein koi bhi do vertices jur sakte hain, is liye rishton ka ek pecheeda jaal (web) ban jata hai.

Misal: social network mein har shakhs bohat se logon se jura ho sakta hai, aur yeh graph banta hai. Yahan koi ek shuruati nuqta nahi, aur logon (vertices) ke kai rabte (edges) ho sakte hain jo tree ki tarah walid-aulad wale sakht rishte par nahi chalte.
Tree se farq: graphs aur trees dono cheezon ke rishte dikhate hain, magar tree asal mein graph ki ek khaas qisam hai, jis ke kuch aham farq hain:

items: Tree darja-bandi wala hota hai: us ki ek hi root node hoti hai jis se baqi saare nodes shaakhon ki tarah nikalte hain. Graph mein darja-bandi ya root zaroori nahi.
Tree mein kinhi do nodes ke darmiyan bilkul ek raasta hota hai, is liye cycle (chakkar) nahi banta. Graph mein do nodes ke darmiyan kai raaste ho sakte hain aur cycles ki ijazat hai.

Trees aksar tarteeb wala data dikhate hain, jaise family tree ya organisational chart. Graphs zyada lachakdar hain aur networks, web links ya transport systems jaise har tarah ke rabte dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Tree aur graph mein do farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Tree ki ek root aur darja-bandi hoti hai, graph mein zaroori nahi. Tree mein do nodes ke beech bilkul ek raasta aur koi cycle nahi; graph mein kai raaste aur cycles ho sakte hain.

items: Graph: edges se jure vertices; koi ek root nahi; cycles ho sakte hain; tree graph ki khaas qisam hai.
